description: Opt-in docs-only lane for review-gate: a PR whose every changed and renamed-from path matches passes without a PR review. Copy to `.github/docs-only-paths.json` to opt in. dirs/dir_suffixes: files under those directories with those suffixes; top_level_suffix: repo-root files with that suffix; excluded_names: file names (any case) that are never docs, at any depth.
